Messages.Author: Jason Bell
Messages.Body:
I have some questions about the "may not be used during an
action" restriction on Heidelburg Castle.

What are the limits of this restriction?
Must I be given an opportunity after the previous action is
completed to use the castle before the acting Methuselah may
declare another action?
May I use the castle in response to someone announcing an action?
May I back them out of their announced action to use the castle?

- Jason Bell

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jason Bell wrote:
>
> I have some questions about the "may not be used during an
> action" restriction on Heidelburg Castle.
>
> What are the limits of this restriction?

Just that.
It can be used at any time other than during an action.

> Must I be given an opportunity after the previous action is
> completed to use the castle before the acting Methuselah may
> declare another action?

Yes.

> May I use the castle in response to someone announcing an action?

No.

> May I back them out of their announced action to use the castle?

Not if you had an opportunity to use it before the action
was annouced. As with all other effects, you cannot be denied the
option to use it just by someone trying to skip past the stage at
which it could be used.
